payload.summary: Prepare releases through one exact reviewed npm tarball and deterministic metadata sidecar before manual publication.
gates: Use a fresh isolated writable npm cache; run the direct generated-version check before frozen script-disabled dependency installation, then typecheck, full tests, lint, benchmark check, deterministic build, and tracked-and-untracked clean-tree gates.

Create and retain package-artifacts/encephalon-0.3.0.tgz only through the package authority; verify its metadata sidecar, rerun the supplied-tarball package check, the pinned v0.2 upgrade/downgrade compatibility authority, the tarball-only publish dry run, and direct Encephalon validation against the same reviewed bytes.

Record byte size, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, npm integrity, package version, source commit, and the fixed repository-relative path; require reviewed pull-request and trusted-main tarball byte identity before publication.
payload.publication: Publication is a manual tarball-only action: npm publish <reviewed-candidate.tgz>. Never rebuild or publish a directory, and never upload without the maintainer final explicit approval after merge and green main.

searchText: release preparation exact reviewed npm tarball metadata sidecar compatibility oracle clean tree manual tarball only publication explicit approval
subject: workflow.release-prepare
